newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Avis Europe IPO to cut D'Ieteren stake to 62 pct.
newsitem.headline: Avis Europe IPO to cut D'Ieteren stake to 62 pct.

text.p: Car rental company Avis Europe, which plans to list part of its capital in London, said on Friday that as a result of the offering the stake held by its majority shareholder would fall to about 62 percent.
Leading Belgian car importer and distributor D'leteren currently holds 77.1 percent of Avis Europe.

The issue of 215 million shares is expected to raise around 237 million stg, giving Avis Europe a market capitalisation of between 629 and 734 million stg. The proceeds of the listing will pay off debts, help develop rental activities and buy back General Motors' stake in Avis Europe.
